title: Manasseh
summary: Manasseh is dated in Raleigh's chronological table (1617), column Iuda, by a yeere of the World. Jones, Appendix F (23rd ed., 2026), dates this and sets the sort.
description: Added from the Raleigh import (The History of the World, 1617). Raleigh is display-only. He gives a yeere of the World, not a BC year, and Jones, Appendix F (23rd ed., 2026), dates this and sets the sort.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 709 BC (no higher-tier year available).

birth.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 279 (PDF p. 314)

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 789a
reign.note: Year cell "3998 3316 323". The third printed figure 323 is the column "Temple", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 55 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row. Column: Iuda..

reign.citation: Hales, A New Analysis of Chronology and Geography, History and Prophecy, 2nd ed., corrected and improved (London: C. J. G. & F. Rivington, 1830), vol. II, Synopsis of the Chronology, p. xxxvi
reign.note: Raleigh’s Manasseh in the Judah column. Not Manasseh the son of Joseph.
